itens.trecho: Season 2 Review Click here for a video version of this review: In 2019 the chance to see two of my childhood crushes in a TV show together drew me to the Netflix show Dead to Me. The show immediately hooked me with its mix of fun black comedy and drama, and the first season finished up leaving us wishing there was more.
A dark comedy, we written and acted, looking forward to season 2! Good to see Christina applegate back in a solid TV show again.
